scenario: A hospital compliance office uses an agent pipeline to produce its annual Stark Law and Anti-Kickback Statute referral-arrangement compliance report. The pipeline processes a referral log, a vendor-contract register, and a set of compensation agreements for specialist physician groups. It aggregates per-physician referral volumes and compensation totals, evaluates each financial arrangement against Stark safe-harbor and AKS safe-harbor criteria (fair-market-value, commercial-reasonableness, and set-in-advance tests), and drafts a compliance determination memo stating whether all arrangements conform or whether any present material risk.
info_flow: ub2-csv-data-analyzer ingests referral_log.csv, vendor_contracts.csv, and compensation_agreements.csv, then computes per-physician annual compensation totals and referral volumes → presale-regulation-auditor evaluates each compensation arrangement against Stark and AKS safe-harbor criteria and produces a rule-status inventory → legaldoc-ai drafts the final compliance determination memo summarizing the regulatory findings.
